## What is Protein Modeling?

Protein modeling is the process of predicting or analyzing the three-dimensional structure of a protein based on its amino acid sequence.

These models help researchers understand protein function and assess whether genetic variants may affect stability or biological activity.

---

## Why It Matters

In genomics, protein modeling provides a way to interpret sequence variation in a functional context, especially when working with non-model organisms where experimental structures are unavailable.
